create_FileListDataset: create a FileListDataset from numpy image and label arrays with optional transforms
get_downstream_dataset_imagefolder: get a downstream ImageFolder dataset from a catalog entry with a given transform
get_downstream_dataset_special: get a downstream special dataset like CIFAR10 or MNIST from a catalog
get_downstream_dataset_filelist: get a downstream FileListDataset from a catalog entry with numpy image and label files
use_pil_loader: use pil_loader to open an image file path and convert it to RGB
